Name: Armageddon
Description: The place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon, where the kings of the earth are gathered for the battle of the great day of God Almighty; commonly identified with Megiddo, though the passage also carries a symbolic reading.
BiblicalSignificance: Armageddon is the gathering place of the last battle in Revelation: every earthly power assembled, and the outcome already declared by the One who comes as a thief.
